title: AWS Marketplace Registration Error
description: Error body for POST /api/v1/billing/marketplace/register. Every error branch returns exactly `{"error": <fixed literal>}` -- no `success`/`message` envelope fields, unlike error_envelope_schema.json. 404 = integration disabled (checked before any other validation); 400 = the x-amzn-marketplace-token field was missing from both form data and JSON body; 502 = AWS could not resolve the supplied token (TokenResolutionError). See src/routes/marketplace_routes.py:register.

enum: AWS could not resolve this purchase; please retry from AWS Marketplace
